description: The original TREC ad hoc retrieval benchmark using TIPSTER news corpus. Queries are topic descriptions and relevance judgments are pooled from multiple systems.
Cross Language Evaluation Forum benchmark for multilingual and cross-lingual information retrieval systems across European languages.
Microsoft Machine Reading Comprehension dataset for passage retrieval and ranking. Real queries from Bing with human annotated relevant passages.
Heterogeneous benchmark for zero-shot evaluation of retrieval models across 18 datasets including BioASQ FEVER NFCorpus and DBPedia.
Multilingual Information Retrieval Across a Continuum of Languages benchmark covering 18 languages for dense retrieval evaluation.
Open domain question answering benchmark from Google using real questions from Google Search with Wikipedia passages as corpus.
Multi-hop question answering requiring reasoning over multiple Wikipedia paragraphs. Tests complex retrieval and reasoning chains.
Fact Extraction and VERification benchmark requiring retrieval of evidence from Wikipedia to verify claims as supported refuted or not enough info.
